When TermAl remote coordination and the optional Engram Git task sync are ready for a real configured cross-machine test, notify Advisor with the concrete plan/prerequisites. During normal work, record each observed friction as a diagnosed backlog item."
Applied: (1) when TermAl's remote-notification slice (w-7e947cec3d91) and Engram's Git task sync are both ready for a real configured cross-machine test, send Advisor the concrete plan and prerequisites; (2) every observed friction during normal work gets a diagnosed backlog item, as done tonight (for example w-88e5c2fe6985 and w-ab0285840da6). This grants no commit, push, install or restart authority beyond CLAUDE.md.
